security_audit.summary: All 34 static findings are false positives produced by scanner heuristics on Chinese Markdown. The flagged backticks are inline-code formatting, the '../' sequences are relative documentation links, and the entropy flag reflects UTF-8 CJK text rather than encrypted content. No executable code, network access, credential handling, or prompt injection exists in the two packaged files; the only residual concern is that the skill is a thin router whose referenced files are not part of the audited package.

remediation.issue: The published package contains only SKILL.md and agents/openai.yaml, but SKILL.md routes to reference and template files outside its own directory (for example ../CORE.md and ../references/*.md).
remediation.suggestion: Bundle the referenced files with the skill, or document the external framework dependency, so reviewers can audit the complete runtime behavior rather than just the router page.

semantic_findings.title: Skill Depends on Unaudited Files Outside Its Package
semantic_findings.description: SKILL.md is only a router: it instructs the agent to Read files such as ../CORE.md and ../references/*.md that are not included in the audited package, which contains only SKILL.md and agents/openai.yaml. The published artifact therefore cannot function alone, and the agent's actual behavior is governed by files that were not scanned. It also directs the agent to change files under `.cursor/skills/**`, extending the write scope beyond the skill directory.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The routing instructions and the `.cursor/skills/**` write rule are directly visible in SKILL.md, but the referenced files were not available to inspect, so the practical impact is uncertain.

content.user_title: Turn Requirements into Executable AI Plans
content.value_statement: Vague requests waste engineering time and cause rework. This skill turns them into structured execution plans with clear gates, mandatory steps, and acceptance checks.
actual_capabilities: Routes each planning request to the right template for the Direct, Standard, or Full lane.
Blocks document creation until a PM approval step is present, so unapproved changes cannot start.
Drafts execution documents with frozen tables, mandatory steps, delta specs, and acceptance criteria.
Tracks document status from draft to review-pending to ready.
Runs design-pattern checks and lessons-learned scans before mandatory steps are written.
limitations: The skill content is written in Chinese and follows the source document language.
It depends on framework files outside its own package, so it only works inside the ai-gates setup.
It plans and documents the work but does not write or review code on its own.
The Express lane is intentionally disabled for planning tasks.

use_cases.title: Plan a new feature
use_cases.description: Turn a short feature request into a step-by-step execution document with acceptance criteria.

use_cases.title: Standardize team planning
use_cases.description: Apply one reviewable planning format across projects so every plan has the same gates.

use_cases.title: Keep agent workflows gated
use_cases.description: Enforce approval and review steps before any execution document changes state.

prompt_templates.title: First execution plan
prompt_templates.prompt: 策划：为「用户登录增加短信验证码」写一份执行方案。
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner requests a first execution document for a small feature.

prompt_templates.title: Documented bug-fix plan
prompt_templates.prompt: 策划：订单列表偶尔丢数据，先给我一份修 bug 的执行方案，含根因和验收。
prompt_templates.scenario: An engineer wants a written plan before changing code.

prompt_templates.title: Multi-step full plan
prompt_templates.prompt: 策划 Full 车道：把「支持微信登录」拆成多个 Step，每步给出 Mandatory、Delta Spec 和验收 A#。
prompt_templates.scenario: A tech lead needs a full multi-step plan for a larger change.

prompt_templates.title: Review-gated handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: 策划：出方案后先过方案审，再给我一轮确认包，含现在/改完/可停/怎判/不修。
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user wants the plan to pass review and confirmation gates before implementation.

output_examples.input: 策划：为「用户登录增加短信验证码」写一份执行方案。
output: Step 1: Add SMS provider client. Mandatory step, delta spec, acceptance A1.
Step 2: Add verification code endpoint. Mandatory step, delta spec, acceptance A2.
Gate: the plan passes review before any code changes start.

output_examples.input: 策划 Full 车道：把「支持微信登录」拆成多个 Step。
output: Step 1: Add the OAuth callback route. Acceptance A1.
Step 2: Store the union id. Acceptance A2.
Open question: a circuit check is required because there are two or more steps.

output_examples.input: 策划：订单列表偶尔丢数据，先给一份修 bug 的执行方案。
output: Root cause: the pagination key is dropped when the filter changes.
Mandatory: reproduce the missing rows before the fix.
Acceptance: the list returns the same rows across filter changes.

best_practices: State a clear goal and the affected area so the plan can name real files.
Review the acceptance criteria before any code changes start.
Keep confirmation to one round instead of splitting it into many rounds.
anti_patterns: Requesting a plan with no goal, scope, or acceptance criteria.
Starting code changes before the plan passes review.
Splitting confirmation into many rounds instead of one package.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It turns a request into a reviewable execution document with gates, steps, and acceptance checks.

faq.question: Which tools support it?
faq.answer: It works with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What language does it use?
faq.answer: The skill content is written in Chinese and follows the source document language.

faq.question: Does it write code for me?
faq.answer: No. It produces the plan and the acceptance criteria. You or another agent write the code.

faq.question: Why is the Express lane blocked?
faq.answer: The framework routes Express work to the PM role, so this skill does not plan Express tasks.

faq.question: What is the PM gate?
faq.answer: It stops the skill from creating or changing execution documents until a PM step exists.
